description: Upload an image or file into the project's Media and get its asset — the id is the value an image or file field holds, and the site shows it with assetUrl(id) from the SDK. Over this connection Mapled downloads a public address (url): PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG up to 10 MB, PDF and 3D models (GLB, or glTF as one file with its buffers embedded) up to 25 MB; the same file twice is one asset (deduplicated: true). A file in the site's repository is uploaded from there with the CLI: `npx -y @mapled/cli media upload <path>` — or `--run <runId>` for every file of an approved setup plan. During setup pass the approved plan's runId and the source as the plan writes it (for a url, the url itself) so apply_setup_plan puts the asset into the records.

path.description: A file on your machine: not readable over this connection — upload it with `npx -y @mapled/cli media upload <path>`.

runId.description: The approved setup run whose plan names this file.

source.description: The media source as the plan writes it; defaults to url.

url.description: A public http(s) address of the file.

name: upload_media
